sprints.name: Sprint 1 - Foundation
sprints.goal: Repo, auth, RBAC, resource CRUD and containerised dev environment

sprints.name: Sprint 2 - Core workflows
sprints.goal: Requests, approvals, atomic allocation, conflict-free booking and CI pipeline

sprints.name: Sprint 3 - Booking UX, maintenance & dashboards
sprints.goal: Calendar view, returns, maintenance tickets, notifications, audit log, dashboards

sprints.name: Sprint 4 - DevOps & observability
sprints.goal: CD to GHCR, Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, alerts and Jira automation

epics.description: Repository, branching strategy, sign-up/login with JWT and role-based access control.

stories.summary: Set up Git repository, branching strategy and project scaffolding
acceptance: backend and frontend skeletons run locally

stories.summary: As an employee I can sign up for an account
acceptance: Public sign-up always creates EMPLOYEE role even if ADMIN is sent
Password is stored as bcrypt hash

stories.summary: As a user I can log in and stay logged in (JWT)
acceptance: Valid credentials return a signed JWT

stories.summary: Role-based access control for ADMIN and EMPLOYEE
acceptance: Frontend hides admin menus for employees

stories.summary: As a user I can update my profile and change my password
acceptance: Name, department and phone are editable
Password change requires the current password

epics.description: Admins maintain the inventory of laptops, monitors, printers, rooms and projectors.

stories.summary: As an admin I can add, edit and delete resources
acceptance: Cannot delete an allocated resource or one with upcoming bookings
Every change is written to the audit log

stories.summary: As a user I can search and filter the resource catalogue
acceptance: Search by name, tag or location

stories.summary: As an admin I can change a resource status (retire, maintenance)
acceptance: ALLOCATED can only be set by the allocation workflow

epics.description: Employees request assets, admins approve them and assets are allocated and returned.

stories.summary: As an employee I can request an available asset
acceptance: Only AVAILABLE, non-shared assets can be requested

stories.summary: As an admin I can approve or reject requests
Prevent the same asset being allocated twice (atomic allocation)
acceptance: AVAILABLE -> ALLOCATED is a single conditional update

stories.summary: Return workflow with condition inspection
acceptance: Admin checks the asset in as GOOD or DAMAGED
DAMAGED opens a HIGH priority maintenance ticket

stories.summary: As an admin I can allocate an asset directly to an employee

epics.description: Conference rooms and projectors are booked by time slot without overlaps.

stories.summary: As a user I can book a room or projector for a time slot
Reject overlapping bookings with 409 Conflict
acceptance: Overlap rule: newStart < existingEnd AND newEnd > existingStart
Conflict metric is exported to Prometheus

stories.summary: Day-view booking calendar
acceptance: Click an empty slot to book

stories.summary: Cancel a booking (owner or admin)

epics.description: Fault reporting, repair tracking, in-app notifications and a full audit trail.

stories.summary: As a user I can report a faulty resource
acceptance: Only one open ticket per resource
Employees can only report shared resources or their own assets

stories.summary: As an admin I can progress and resolve maintenance tickets
Audit log of every state-changing action
acceptance: Who, what, when for every action

stories.summary: In-app notifications

epics.description: Role-specific dashboards with live statistics and charts.

stories.summary: Admin dashboard with KPIs and charts
Employee dashboard
acceptance: My assets, requests, bookings and open issues

epics.description: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana and Jira automation (no Kubernetes).

stories.summary: Dockerize backend and frontend with multi-stage builds
acceptance: Backend runs as non-root with HEALTHCHECK
Frontend served by nginx which proxies /api

stories.summary: Docker Compose stack for the whole system
acceptance: One command starts MongoDB, API, frontend, Prometheus, Grafana and exporters

stories.summary: GitHub Actions CI pipeline
acceptance: Backend tests against an ephemeral MongoDB
Runs on every push and PR

stories.summary: Full-stack smoke test in CI with docker compose
CD: publish versioned images to GitHub Container Registry
acceptance: v* tags -> semver tags and GitHub Release

stories.summary: Instrument the API with Prometheus metrics
Provision Grafana dashboards as code
Prometheus alert rules
acceptance: API down, DB down, 5xx rate, p95 latency, critical tickets

stories.summary: Jira <-> GitHub integration
acceptance: Commits and PRs referencing an issue key comment on it
Merged PR moves the issue to Done
CI failure on main raises a Bug
